records.note: Planned four-hour classification flight, including three hours at 38,000 ft. Classified man-flights equal no descent + aeroembolism descent + other descent. Screening eliminations at 5,000 ft are outside the classified denominator. Time, pressure and weekday are alternative cross-tabs with incompatible margins. Preserve printed totals and percentages. In particular, low-pressure San Antonio prints 133 aeroembolism descents and 1173 total subjects run while its classified components sum to 1118. Hour counts describe reported symptoms conditionally, with no exposed risk set or individual censoring.
